label: Net.GeneratePeriodicBandwidthSpike

label: net.HandshakeResendInterval

label: net.InstantReplayProcessQueuedBunchesMillisecondLimit
help: Time threshold for processing queued bunches during instant replays. If it takes longer than this in a single frame, wait until the next frame to continue processing queued bunches. For unlimited time, set to 0.

label: net.IpConnectionDisableResolution
help: If enabled, any future ip connections will not use resolution methods.

label: net.IpConnectionUseSendTasks
help: If true, the IpConnection will call the socket's SendTo function in a task graph task so that it can run off the game thread.

label: net.IpNetDriverReceiveThreadPollTimeMS
help: If net.IpNetDriverUseReceiveThread is true, the maximum number of packets that can be waiting in the queue. Additional packets received will be dropped.

label: net.IpNetDriverReceiveThreadQueueMaxPackets
help: If net.IpNetDriverUseReceiveThread is true, the maximum number of packets that can be waiting in the queue. Additional packets received will be dropped.

label: net.IpNetDriverUseReceiveThread
help: If true, the IpNetDriver will call the socket's RecvFrom function on a separate thread (not the game thread)

label: net.Iris.SaturateBandwidth
help: Whether to saturate the bandwidth or not. Default is false.

label: Net.IsPushModelEnabled
help: Whether or not Push Model is enabled. This networking mode allows game code to notify the networking system of changes, rather than scraping.

label: net.ListActorChannels
help: Lists open actor channels

label: net.ListNetGUIDExports
help: Lists open actor channels

label: net.ListNetGUIDs
help: Lists NetGUIDs for actors

label: Net.LogPendingGuidsOnShutdown
help: Record and report to the perf tracking system the processing time of the GameNetDriver's TickFlush.

label: Net.LogSkippedRepNotifies
help: Log when the networking code skips calling a repnotify clientside due to the property value not changing.

label: net.LogUnhandledFaults
help: Whether or not to warn about unhandled net faults (could be deliberate, depending on implementation). 0 = off, 1 = log once, 2 = log always.

label: net.MagicHeader
help: String representing binary bits which are prepended to every packet sent by the game. Max length: 32 bits.

label: Net.MakeBpPropertiesPushModel
help: Whether or not properties declared in Blueprints will be forced to used Push Model

label: net.MaxAggregateIPLogs
help: The maximum number of IP's to include in aggregated pre-connection logging, before such logging is disabled altogether (Min: 1, Max: 128).

label: net.MaxChannelSize

label: net.MaxClientGuidRemaps
help: Max client resolves of unmapped network guids per tick

label: net.MaxConnectionsToTickPerServerFrame
help: When non-zero, the maximum number of channels that will have changed replicated to them per server update

label: net.MaxConstructedPartialBunchSizeBytes
help: The maximum size allowed for Partial Bunches.

label: net.MaxFarmPlayersOverride
help: If greater than 0, will override the standard max farm players count. Useful for testing full farms.

label: net.MaxIPHitLogs
help: The maximum number of times to individually log a specific IP pre-connection, before aggregating further logs.

label: net.MaxNetStringSize
help: Maximum allowed size for strings sent/received by the netcode (in bytes).

label: net.MaxNumberOfAllowedTArrayChangesPerUpdate
help: /Script/NetCore

label: net.MaxRPCPerNetUpdate
help: Maximum number of unreliable multicast RPC calls allowed per net update, additional ones will be dropped

label: net.MaxSerializedNetExportGroups
help: Maximum number of network export groups we would expect to receive in a bunch

label: net.MaxSerializedNetExportsPerGroup
help: Maximum number of network exports in each group we would expect to receive in a bunch

label: net.MaxSerializedNetGuids
help: Maximum number of network guids we would expect to receive in a bunch

label: net.MaxSerializedReplayNetGuids
help: Maximum number of network guids we would expect to receive in replay export data.

label: net.MinHandshakeVersion
help: The minimum supported stateless handshake protocol version (numeric).

label: net.Montage.Debug
help: Prints Replication information about AnimMontages

label: net.NetPingEnabled
help: Whether or not the NetPing ping handling interface is enabled. Used for centralized ping tracking, and ICMP/UDP ping. (Valid values: 0 = Off, 1 = Enabled for client, 2 = Enabled for server and client, 3 = Enabled for server only)

label: net.NetPingICMPInterval
help: Specifies the interval (in seconds) for performing ICMP pings.

label: net.NetPingTimeoutDisableThreshold
help: The number of times to send an ICMP/UDP ping when at a failure/timeout rate of 100%, before giving up and disabling pings.

label: net.NetPingTypes
help: A comma-delimited list of EPingType pings to enable, and (optionally) the EPingAverageType averaging to apply to the ping (e.g: "RoundTrip=None,RoundTripExclFrame=PlayerStateAvg,ICMP=MovingAverage").

label: net.NetPingUDPInterval
help: Specifies the interval (in seconds) for performing UDP pings.

label: net.NetPingUDPPort
help: For 'UDPQoS' ping type, sets the port used for pinging.

label: net.NetServerMoveTimestampExpiredWarningThreshold
help: Tolerance for ServerMove() to warn when client moves are expired more than this time threshold behind the server.

label: net.OodleClientEnableMode
help: When to enable compression on the client (overrides the 'ClientEnableMode' .ini setting).

label: net.OodleMinSizeForCompression
help: The minimum size an outgoing packet must be, for it to be considered for compression (does not count overhead of handler components which process packets after Oodle).

label: net.OodleServerEnableMode
help: When to enable compression on the server (overrides the 'ServerEnableMode' .ini setting).

label: net.OptimizedRemapping
help: Uses optimized path to remap unmapped network guids

label: net.PackageMap.DebugAll
help: Debugs PackageMap serialization of all objects

label: net.PackageMap.DebugObject
help: Debugs PackageMap serialization of objectPartial name of object to debug

label: net.PackageMap.LongLoadThreshhold
help: Threshhold time in seconds for printing long load warnings in object serialization

label: net.PacketOrderCorrectionEnableThreshold
help: The number of 'out of order' packet sequences that need to occur, before correction is enabled.

label: net.PacketOrderMaxCachedPackets
help: (NOTE: Must be power of 2!) The maximum number of packets to cache while waiting for missing packet sequences, before treating missing packets as lost.

label: net.PacketOrderMaxMissingPackets
help: The maximum number of missed packet sequences that is allowed, before treating missing packets as lost.

label: net.PartialBunchReliableThreshold
help: If a bunch is broken up into this many partial bunches are more, we will send it reliable even if the original bunch was not reliable. Partial bunches are atonmic and must all make it over to be used

label: net.PingExcludeFrameTime
help: If true, game frame times are subtracted from calculated ping to approximate actual network ping

label: net.PingUsePacketRecvTime
help: Use OS or Receive Thread packet receive time, for calculating the ping. Excludes frame time.

label: net.ProcessQueuedBunchesMillisecondLimit
help: Time threshold for processing queued bunches. If it takes longer than this in a single frame, wait until the next frame to continue processing queued bunches. For unlimited time, set to 0.

label: net.ProxyReplicatedTransferTimeout
help: How long a proxy replicating actor should wait to be destroyed if never reattached to a different connection.

label: net.PushModelConnectionBatchSize
help: If 1, clean references and the server side guid cache. If 2, also clean the client side guid caches

label: net.PushModelSkipUndirtiedFastArrays
help: When true, include fast arrays when skipping objects that we can safely see aren't dirty.

label: net.PushModelSkipUndirtiedReplication
help: When true, skip replicating any objects that we can safely see aren't dirty.

label: net.PushModelValidateSkipUpdate
help: If enabled, detect when we thought we could skip an object replication based on push model state, but we sent data anyway.

label: net.QuantizeActorLocationOnSpawn
help: When enabled, we will quantize Location for newly spawned actors to a single decimal of precision.

label: net.QuantizeActorScaleOnSpawn
help: When enabled, we will quantize Scale for newly spawned actors to a single decimal of precision.

label: net.QuantizeActorVelocityOnSpawn
help: When enabled, we will quantize Velocity for newly spawned actors to a single decimal of precision.

label: net.QueuedBunchInitialTimeoutSeconds
help: Time in seconds to wait for queued bunches on a channel to flush before logging a warning the first time it happens for a channel.

label: net.QueuedBunchTimeFailsafeSeconds
help: Amount of time in seconds to wait with queued bunches before forcibly processing them all, ignoring the NetDriver's HasExceededIncomingBunchFrameProcessingTime.

label: net.QueuedBunchTimeoutSeconds
help: Time in seconds to wait for queued bunches on a channel to flush before logging a warning after it has already timed out once.

label: net.RandomizeSequence
help: Randomize initial packet sequence, can provide some obfuscation

label: net.RcvThreadShouldSleepForLongRecvErrors
help: Whether or not the receive thread should sleep for RecvFrom errors which are expected to last a long time. 0 = don't sleep, 1 = sleep, 2 = exit receive thread.

label: net.RcvThreadSleepTimeForWaitableErrorsInSeconds
help: Time the receive thread will sleep when a waitable error is returned by a socket operation.

label: net.RecreateSocketCooldown
help: The minimum amount of time, in seconds, between socket recreation attempts.

label: net.RecreateSocketTimeoutThreshold
help: The amount of time, in seconds, without receiving a packet or alternatively without a send ack, before triggering socket recreation. (0.0 = off)

label: net.RecvMultiCapacity
help: When RecvMulti is enabled, this is the number of packets it is allocated to handle per call - bigger is better (especially under a DDoS), but keep an eye on memory cost.

label: net.Reliable.Debug
help: Print all reliable bunches sent over the network

label: net.RelinkMappedReferences
help: Enables Replication Driver. 0 will fallback to legacy NetDriver implementation.

label: Net.RepDriver.Enable
help: Enables Replication Driver. 0 will fallback to legacy NetDriver implementation.

label: Net.RepGraph.ActorComponentFrequency
help: If true, will use ActorComponent NetUpdateFrequency to skip components

label: Net.RepGraph.ActorDiscoveryBudget
help: Set a separate network traffic budget for data sent when opening a new actor channel. Value in kilobytes per second

label: Net.RepGraph.ConditionalBreakpointActorName
help: Helper CVar for debugging. Set this string to conditionally log/breakpoint various points in the repgraph pipeline. Useful for bugs like 'why is this actor channel closing'

label: Net.RepGraph.DormancyNodeObsoleteBehavior
help: This changes how the dormancy node deals with obsolete nodes. 0 = ignore. 1 = lazily destroy the node

label: Net.RepGraph.DormantCellsTTLDefault
help: Determine number of frames cell will be considered visible before dormant dynamic actor destruction kicks in

label: Net.RepGraph.DormantDynamicActorsDestruction
help: If true, irrelevant dormant actors will be destroyed on the client

label: Net.RepGraph.DynamicSpatialFrequency.ForceMaxFreq
help: Forces DSF to set max frame replication periods on all actors (1 frame rep periods). 1 = default replication. 2 = fast path. 3 = Both (effectively, default)

label: Net.RepGraph.FixedBudget
help: Set fixed (independent of frame rate) packet budget. In BIts/frame

label: Net.RepGraph.ForceConnectionViewerPriority
help: Force the connection's player controller and viewing pawn as topmost priority.

label: Net.RepGraph.Frequency.MatchTargetInPIE
help: Explicit override for actor replication frequency

label: Net.RepGraph.Frequency.Override
help: Explicit override for actor replication frequency

label: Net.RepGraph.NbDestroyedGridsToTriggerGC
help: After destroying this many grids, force a garbage collection to free memory

label: Net.RepGraph.NodeSaturationCooldown
help: How long to wait after logging a saturated RepGraph Node before logging again.

label: Net.RepGraph.OutOfRangeDistanceCheckRatio
help: The ratio of DestructInfoMaxDistance that gives the distance traveled before we reevaluate the out of range destroyed actors list

label: Net.RepGraph.Pause
help: Pauses actor replication in the Replication Graph.

label: Net.RepGraph.PrintActorChannelCounters
help: If true, will prune empty lists from graph nodes

label: Net.RepGraph.PrintCullDistances
help: Print the cull distances of RepGraph actors on the server.

label: Net.RepGraph.PrintCullDistancesForConnection
help: Print the cull distances via the ReplicationDebugActor to add the connection cull distances.

label: Net.RepGraph.PrintCulledOnConnectionClasses
help: Debug option to print culling stats

label: Net.RepGraph.PrintTrackClassReplication
help: Debug option to print class replication stats

label: Net.RepGraph.PruneEmptyLists
help: If true, will prune empty lists from graph nodes

label: Net.RepGraph.ReplicatedDormantDestructionInfosPerFrame
help: If CVarRepGraphDormantDynamicActorsDestruction is true, this is the max number of destruction infos sent to a client per frame

label: Net.RepGraph.SetDebugActor
help: Set DebugActorConnectionPair on server, from client. Specify

label: Net.RepGraph.SkipDistanceCull
help: Debug option to skip distance culling during evaluation

label: Net.RepGraph.SkipNotNetReadyForConnection
help: Net.RepGraph.GridSpatialization2DDestroyDormantDynamicActorsDefault

label: Net.RepGraph.Spatial.BiasCreep
help: Changes bias each frame by this much and force rebuld. For stress test debugging

label: Net.RepGraph.Spatial.DebugDynamic
help: Prints debug info whenever dynamic actors changes spatial cells (0 - disabled; 1 - move events and errors; 2 - cell by cell comparison)

label: Net.RepGraph.Spatial.DebugNextNewActor
help: Pauses updating dynamic actor positions in the spatialization nodes.

label: Net.RepGraph.Spatial.PauseDynamic
help: Pauses updating dynamic actor positions in the spatialization nodes.

label: Net.RepGraph.TrackClassReplication
help: Debug option to track class replication stats

label: Net.RepGraph.UseLegacyBudget
help: Use legacy IsNetReady() to make dynamic packget budgets

label: net.ReplicateCustomDeltaPropertiesInRepIndexOrder
help: If false (default) custom delta properties will replicate in the same order as they're added to the lifetime property array during the call to GetLifetimeReplicatedProps. If true custom delta properties will be replicated in the property RepIndex order, which is typically in increasing property offset order. Note that custom delta properties are always serialized after regular properties.

label: net.ReplicateOnlyBeginPlay
help: Only allow property replication of actors that had BeginPlay called on them.

label: net.Replication.DebugProperty
help: Debugs Replication of property by name, this should be set to the partial name of the property to debug

label: Net.Replication.Parallel
help: Uses parallelization in the replication. [Server only]

label: Net.RepMovement.DrawDebug
help: Enable actor-component relevancy for replication.

label: net.ReportGameTickFlushTime
help: Record and report to the perf tracking system the processing time of the GameNetDriver's TickFlush.

label: net.ReportSyncLoads
help: If enabled, check the no load flag in GetObjectFromNetGUID before forcing a sync load on packages that are not marked IsFullyLoaded

label: net.RequiredEncryptionNetDriverDefNames
help: Comma-delimited list of NetDriverDefinition's where 'IsEncryptionRequired' will return true, when 'net.AllowEncryption' is 2. (specifying 'all' will enable this for all NetDriverDefinition's)

label: net.ReservedNetGuidSize
help: Reserved size in bytes for NetGUID serialization, used as a placeholder for later serialization

label: net.ResetAckStatePostSeamlessTravel
help: If 1, the server will reset the ack state of the package map after seamless travel. Increases bandwidth usage, but may resolve some issues with GUIDs not being available on clients after seamlessly traveling.

label: Net.ReuseReplicatorsForDormantObjects
help: When true, Server's will persist and attempt to reuse replicators for Dormant Actors and Objects. This can cut down on bandwidth by preventing redundant information from being sent when waking objects from Dormancy.

label: net.RPC.Debug
help: Print all RPC bunches sent over the network.

label: net.RPCDoSAnalyticsMaxRPCs
help: The top 'x' number of RPC's to include in RPC DoS analytics, ranked by RPC rate per Second.

label: net.RPCDoSDetectionOverride
help: Overrides whether or not RPC DoS Detection is enabled per-NetDriver. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled. Example: net.RPCDoSDetectionOverride=GameNetDriver=1,BeaconNetDriver=0

label: net.RPCDoSForcedRPCTracking
help: Sets a single RPC that, when encountered, forcibly enables RPC tracking (limited to one RPC for performance). Can also specify a random chance, between 0.0 and 1.0, for when encountering the RPC enables tracking, and a length of time for leaving tracking enabled (disables the next tick, otherwise).Example (50% chance for 10 seconds): net.RPCDoSForcedRPCTracking=ServerAdmin,0.5,10

label: net.RPCDoSScopeDebugging
help: Sets whether or not debugging/ensures for RPC DoS Tick/Packet scopes should be enabled.

label: net.SafeActorSerialization
help: When true, crash the server if an actor structure (components) is modified during state serialization

label: net.SaturationUpdateDelayFrames
help: Number of frames in which network must be unsaturated before we tell the client.

label: net.ShareInitialCompareState
help: If true and net.ShareShadowState is enabled, attempt to also share initial replication compares across connections.

label: net.ShareSerializedData
help: If true, enable shared serialization system used by replication to reduce CPU usage when multiple clients need the same data

label: net.ShareShadowState
help: If true, work done to compare properties will be shared across connections

label: net.SimulateConnections
help: Starts a Simulated Net Driver

label: net.SkipDeltaStateResetOnNack
help: If enabled, skip delta state reset on Nak for tagged actors.

label: net.SkipReplicatorForDestructionInfos
help: If enabled, skip creation of object replicator in SetChannelActor when we know there is no content payload and we're going to immediately destroy the actor.

label: net.SubObjects.DefaultUseSubObjectReplicationList
help: Do actors and actorcomponents replicate subobjects using the registration method by default.

label: net.SupportFastArrayDelta
help: Whether or not Fast Array Struct Delta Serialization is enabled.

label: net.TickAllOpenChannels
help: If nonzero, each net connection will tick all of its open channels every tick. Leaving this off will improve performance.

label: net.TrackAsyncLoadingGUIDThreshold
help: When > 0, if the Net Connection's owning Controller or Pawn is waiting on Async Loads for longer than this threshold, we will fire a CSV Event to track it. Used for Debugging and Profiling

label: net.TrackAsyncLoadingGUIDThresholdOwner
help: When > 0, if the Net Connection's owning Controller or Pawn is waiting on Async Loads for longer than this threshold, we will fire a CSV Event to track it. Used for Debugging and Profiling

label: net.TrackDormantObjectsByLevel
help: When true, network object list will maintain a set of dormant actors per connnection per level.

label: net.TrackNetSerializeObjectReferences
help: If true, we will create small layouts for Net Serialize Structs if they have Object Properties. This can prevent some Shadow State GC crashes.

label: net.TrackQueuedActorThreshold
help: When > 0, if the Net Connection's owning Controller or Pawn is waiting on Async Loads for longer than this threshold, we will fire a CSV Event to track it. Used for Debugging and Profiling

label: net.TrackQueuedActorThresholdOwner
help: When > 0, if the Net Connection's owning Controller or Pawn has Queued Bunches for longer than this threshold, we will fire a CSV Event to track it. Used for Debugging and Profiling

label: net.UseAdaptiveNetUpdateFrequency
help: If 1, NetUpdateFrequency will be calculated based on how often actors actually send something when replicating

label: net.UseNewS2SRPCRejectionSystem
help: When true, crash the server if an actor structure (components) is modified during state serialization

label: Net.UsePackedShadowBuffers
help: When enabled, FRepLayout will generate shadow buffers that are packed with only the necessary NetProperties, instead of copying entire object state.

label: net.UseRecvMulti
help: If true, and if running on a Unix/Linux platform, multiple packets will be retrieved from the socket with one syscall, improving performance and also allowing retrieval of timestamp information.

label: net.UseRecvTimestamps
help: If true and if net.UseRecvMulti is also true, on a Unix/Linux platform, the kernel timestamp will be retrieved for each packet received, providing more accurate ping calculations.

label: net.ValidateReplicatedPropertyRegistration
help: Warns if replicated properties were not registered in GetLifetimeReplicatedProps.

label: net.VerifyMagicHeader
help: Whether or not verification of the magic header is performed, prior to processing a packet. Disable if transitioning to a new magic header, while wishing to continue supporting the old header for a time.

label: net.VerifyNetClientID
help: Whether or not verification of the packet ClientID value is performed.

label: net.VerifyNetSessionID
help: Whether or not verification of the packet SessionID value is performed.

label: net.VerifyShareSerializedData
help: Debug option to verify shared serialization data during replication

label: net.WithArrayOnRepFix
help: If true, attempt to prevent issues with Arrays not receiving OnRep calls until their size changes if their Archetypes have different values from instances in levels.

label: NetAnalytics.MinimumNumberOfPacketsForBurstTracking
help: The minimum number of packets that must have been notified (in our out) in order to consider a frame for packet loss by percentage.See NetAnalytics.PercentOfDroppedPacketsToConsiderBurst

label: NetAnalytics.NumberOfConsecutiveDroppedPacketsToConsiderBurst
help: The number of packets lost in a row (in or out) for us to consider the frame as having bursts of packet loss.Not affected by NetAnalytics.MinimumNumberOfPacketsForBurstTracking.

label: NetAnalytics.PercentOfDroppedPacketsToConsiderBurst
help: The percentage of packets lost in a frame (in or out) for us to consider the frame as having bursts of packet loss.

label: niagara.CreateShadersOnLoad
help: Whether to create Niagara's simulation shaders on load, which can reduce hitching, but use more memory.  Otherwise they will be created as needed.

label: Niagara.GPUCountBufferSlack
help: Multiplier of the GPU count buffer size to prevent frequent re-allocation.

label: Niagara.GPUCountManager.AllocateIncrement
help: If we run out of space for allocations this is how many allocate rather than a single entry. (default=64)

label: Niagara.GPUCulling
help: Whether to frustum and camera distance cull particles on the GPU

label: Niagara.GPUCulling.CPUToGPUThreshold
help: Particle count to move from a CPU sort to a GPU cull. -1 disables. (default=0)

label: Niagara.GPUSorting.CPUToGPUThreshold
help: Particle count to move from a CPU sort to a GPU sort. -1 disables. (default=-1)

label: Niagara.Landscape.InvalidateRVT
help: If 1, invalidate the RVT tiles overlapping the world bounds of Niagara system when it's spawned, if any of its NiagaraDataInterfaceLandscapes sample RVTs

label: Niagara.MinCulledGPUInstanceCount
help: Minimum number of culled (per-view) instance count entries allocated in the global buffer. (default=2048)

label: Niagara.MinGPUInstanceCount
help: Minimum number of instance count entries allocated in the global buffer. (default=2048)

label: Niagara.RadixSortThreshold
help: Instance count at which radix sort gets used instead of introspective sort.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.GpuAllocateMaxCount
help: When enabled (default) we allocate the maximum number of required elements.This can result in memory bloat if the count is highly variable but will be more stable performance wise

label: Niagara.Ribbon.GpuBufferAlign
help: When not allocating the maximum number of required elements we align up the request elements to this size to improve buffer reuse.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.GpuBufferCachePurgeCounter
help: The number of frames we hold onto ribbon buffer for.Where 0 (Default) we purge them if not used next frame.Negative values will purge the buffers the same frame, essentially zero reusing.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.GpuEnabled
help: Enable any GPU ribbon related code (including GPU init).

label: Niagara.Ribbon.GpuInitMode
help: Modifies the GPU initialization mode used, i.e. offloading CPU calculations to the GPU.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.MinSegmentLength
help: Min length of niagara ribbon segments. (default=1)

label: Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.Enabled
help: Determine if we allow tesellation on this platform or not.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MaxErrorScreenPercentage
help: Screen percentage used to compute the tessellation factor.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MaxInterp
help: When TessellationAngle is > 0, this is the maximum tesselation factor.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MinAbsoluteError
help: Minimum absolute world size error when tessellating.

label: Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MinAngle
help: Ribbon segment angle to tesselate in radian. (default=15 degrees)

label: niagara.ShowShaderCompilerWarnings
help: When set to 1, will display all warnings from Niagara shader compiles.

label: Niagara.WaveIntrinsics

label: np2.EnableDebugRPC

label: np2.EnableNetworkPhysicsPrediction
help: Enables network physics prediction

label: np2.NumRedundantCmds
help: Number of redundant user cmds to send per frame

label: NPC.AllowDoorAutoAccessToAllNPCs
help: if this option is on, all the NPCs can walk through the pentashield doors. If not, only assigned room descriptors can have a access.

label: NPC.AllowDoorAutoAccessToAllNPCsRadius
help: When a radius is set, all NPCs will be granted access to doors within the radius when they spawn. This is applied when NPCAllowDoorAutoAccessToAllNPCs is on. default: 100000(1km)

label: NPC.AttackLimitOverride
help: If > 0, override the number of NPCs that are allowed to attack the same target at the same time. NPC.EnableNpcAttackLimits must be set as well.

label: NPC.DoorAutoAccessRadius
help: When a radius is set, NPCs will be granted access to doors within the radius when they spawn. default: 25000(250m)

label: NPC.DummyWeaponRotationRateOverride
help: If set value > 0, shooting weapon will use dummy rotation rate override instead of the weapon's configured one.

label: NPC.EnableDebugFacingTargetCheck
help: If set to 1, show debug info when NPCs checks if facing their target before firing their weapon

label: NPC.EnableFacingTargetCheck
help: If set to 1, NPCs will check if facing their target before firing their weapon

label: NPC.EnableNpcAttackLimits
help: If set to 1, NPCs will utilize the attack limit curve when determining if they can attack a target

label: NPC.EnableWeaponRotationRateOverride
help: If set to 1, NPC's yaw rotation rate is overriden if the rotation rate override  firing pattern config has a  or dummy weapon rotation rate override is set.

label: NPC.FacingTargetAngleStartThreshold
help: Set yaw angle threshold to prevent NPCs from start shooting their weapon if they aren't facing their target
